name: How long does an insulation upgrade typically take?
description: An upgrade can take from one day for an attic to several days for more extensive projects, depending on home size and scope.

mainEntity.name: How long does an insulation upgrade typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation upgrade varies depending on the size of your home, the areas being insulated (attic, walls, crawl space), and the type of insulation chosen. A typical attic insulation upgrade for an average-sized home might be completed within one to two days. More extensive projects involving wall cavity insulation or multiple areas could take several days to a week. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements.
